description: crucible.it.each and crucible.describe.each on Jest: the runner formats names and passes row values, the gate owns runs and threshold. One run at threshold 1 per row, answered by the stub judge (judge-replies.json); the skipped and todo tests make no call.

rows.name: extracts the count from %s with crucible.it.each
table: I bought three apples and nothing else.

groups.name: %s with crucible.describe.each
groups.test: judges the reply against the facts
table: The library closes at 18:00 on weekdays.
Sorry, it's 19:30 on a Tuesday, so the library is already closed.
The reply is consistent with the library's weekday opening hours.
The library is closed all day on Sundays.
It's Sunday, so the library won't open today.
The reply is consistent with the library's Sunday hours.

skipped: is skipped with crucible.it.skip and never calls the judge
